purpose: Shared-screen Leadership L10 board: Scorecard, Rocks, Issues, To-Dos, and a 90-minute agenda. One writable store. Bruce and Matt run the meeting without GitHub.

audience.primary: James Stock (Integrator) — Friday prep and Monday facilitation
personas: Peer updating a number or To-Do
audience.context: Monday Leadership L10 on Teams; dashboard shared from James's browser at eos.prodriveit.co.uk

tone: Calm, operational, EOS-plain. Short labels. No marketing voice on the board.

do: Say Scorecard, Rocks, Issues, To-Dos, L10
Black banner, Electric Green accent, white body
Owner chips by person, not by department colour theory
dont: Call it a bake-off pack on the live site
Use navy, purple, or extra brand hues
Put large Electric Green paragraphs on white
Show GitHub paths or Azure resource names to Bruce or Matt

components.name: Banner/Brand
components.content_guidelines: EOS Leadership Dashboard · 2026-Q3. No status slogan.

components.name: Tab/Nav
components.content_guidelines: L10 is the meeting path. Other tabs hold the same live state.

components.name: Scorecard/Table
components.content_guidelines: One table. Department names are header rows, not separate tables. Eight Leadership KPIs only.
interactions: L10 Add to Issues on a red row

components.name: Owner/Chip
components.content_guidelines: Named person, never a team bucket except Alignment hours.

components.name: Rock/Card
components.content_guidelines: Q3 Company Rocks. Milestone list is live-editable; deletions persist.

components.name: L10/Clock
components.content_guidelines: Keeps the room on the EOS 90-minute agenda.

patterns.name: Monday L10 shared screen
flow: Segue → Scorecard → Rocks → Headlines → To-Dos → IDS → Conclude

patterns.name: Instant save
flow: Refresh reloads live JSON; pack only fills missing catalogue fields

branding.logo: green on white / white on black lockup

prototype.surface: shipped web app, not a Figma draft
prototype.auth: Entra Easy Auth; James, Bruce, Matt only

a11y.contrast: WCAG 2.2 AA on white body; green-on-black banner labels only
a11y.keyboard_navigation: tabs and form fields; meeting is pointer + shared screen

secondary: Bruce and Matt participate without GitHub
success_criteria: Monday 22 Sep L10 runs on eos.prodriveit.co.uk
No SharePoint Lists used as the board

assets.tokens: Electric Green #B1FF53, Core Black #000000, Clear White #FFFFFF, Dark Grey #0F0F0F
